def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # A full-height 2-line is the ruler. Continue the object-area boundary
    # through the grid in color 8: on the right use the first empty column
    # after the object; on the left use the empty column adjacent to its edge.
    divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    if not divs:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    d = divs[0]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    lo, hi = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    if lo > d:
        mark = lo - 1 if lo - d > 1 else hi + 1
    elif hi < d:
        mark = hi + 1 if d - hi > 1 else lo - 1
    else:
        mark = None
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if mark is not None and 0 <= mark < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][mark] = 8
    return out
